scares.description: A dark figure moves behind Marvin.
A woman jumps out at Marvin to scare him as a joke.
As Marvin looks around the room he suddenly spots a girl jumping up and down on the bed. Not really a jump scare, but accompanied by a loud sound.
The little girl appears out of the darkness and runs into the elevator.
Marvin turns around and the policeman is standing right in front of him.
The camera scrolls to the hallway to reveal the ghost woman kneeling down in front of a door, accompanied by a loud sound effect.
The policeman runs out of a hallway and towards Marvin.
